materialsGuidance.Aluminum: 6061 / 6000-series aluminum is usually the value lane here, not a complete-weight guarantee. Battery, motor, fork, wheels and accessories dominate carried mass. A carbon drive belt is not a carbon frame.
materialsGuidance.Steel / iron: Often heavier in cheap electric folders; do not infer complete weight from price or frame label. A steel fork does not make an aluminum-frame bike all-steel.
materialsGuidance.Magnesium: Not automatically lighter: the Haze claims 48 lb with battery scope unresolved. Hinge design, construction and complete weight matter more than the label.
materialsGuidance.Carbon: Discovered carbon-frame options were beyond budget or unverified. Net weights can omit pedals, racks and fenders.
materialsGuidance.Buying rule: Compare ready-to-ride weight including battery and necessary accessories. Confirm tall-rider reach, knee clearance, folded carry point, replacement-battery support, electrical certification and return freight before buying.
